Go.Shop | Product Builder — Growth Channels | Remote (GMT to GMT+8, London travel) | REMOTE

Go.Shop is the AI-powered platform enabling creators to build and scale consumer product brands — the infrastructure layer for creator-led DTC. Founded by serial entrepreneurs with previous exits.

We're hiring our third Product Builder to own Growth Channels end-to-end as PM, designer, and engineer in one person — the platform and tooling that grows creator brands across creator marketing, affiliate, email, paid media, and more.

You'll work on: - Creator marketing & affiliate: discovery, recruitment, program management, affiliate asset generation, UGC - Paid media & conversion: ad creative generation, ad management, paid amplification automation, CRO - Attribution & AI growth agents: cross-channel analytics (Shopify, Klaviyo, Meta, TikTok), bottom-up forecasting, agents that recommend campaigns and execute playbooks with human approval

Tech Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Python, Postgres/Supabase, Claude/Cursor for AI-assisted dev, martech APIs (Klaviyo, Meta Ads, TikTok, Shopify)

Requirements: - Hybrid product-engineering profile: engineer with strong product sense, or PM who codes well — you own product decisions AND ship the code - Full-stack capable: architecture, APIs, databases, data pipelines, production deploys - Strong growth/martech grasp: funnels, attribution, channel economics; up to date with current AI marketing tools - Actively building with AI today (prototypes, agents, workflows)

Perks: Stock options, salary based on location and experience, real ownership from day one in a small high-trust team.

Apply: jobs@goshopbrands.com
